risks.why: All CRM data (_users, _contacts, _leads, _payments, consent) is stored in Python lists/dicts
risks.impact: CRITICAL - Data loss on restart, no persistence, no ACID guarantees
risks.mitigation: P0: Migrate to PostgreSQL with SQLAlchemy ORM. Use Alembic for migrations. ETA: 16-24 hours

risks.item: No governance layer for AI suggestions
risks.why: Missing change_log, task_logs, audit_issues tables and state machine
risks.impact: HIGH - AI could push changes to production without approval/audit trail
risks.mitigation: P0: Implement Step 02 (Data Model) and Step 03 (Governance) before any AI automation. ETA: 12 hours

risks.item: No job scheduler for AI automation
risks.why: Redis present but Celery not configured. No cron jobs defined
risks.impact: HIGH - Cannot run SERP scraping, anomaly detection, or automated workflows
risks.mitigation: P1: Set up Celery workers with Redis broker. Define job schedules. ETA: 8 hours

risks.why: SECRET_KEY, DB passwords in .env files and docker-compose.yml
risks.impact: MEDIUM - Secrets visible in process list, logs, and version control
risks.mitigation: P1: Use HashiCorp Vault or AWS Secrets Manager. Rotate all secrets. ETA: 6 hours

risks.why: Basic health checks exist but no structured logging, metrics, or tracing
risks.impact: MEDIUM - Blind to AI job failures, performance issues, and errors in production
risks.mitigation: P2: Add Prometheus + Grafana for metrics, ELK/Loki for logs. Sentry for errors. ETA: 8 hours

risks.why: No backup procedures, no point-in-time recovery, no failover
risks.impact: CRITICAL - Catastrophic data loss if database corruption or deletion
risks.mitigation: P0: Implement Step 14 (Backups/DR). Daily automated backups to S3. ETA: 6 hours

risks.why: No LangChain service, no vector DB (Qdrant/Pinecone), no embedding workers
risks.impact: HIGH - Cannot implement RAG, prompt library, or AI-powered SEO features
risks.mitigation: P1: Deploy Step 04 (Retrieval Wrapper). Use Qdrant for vectors. ETA: 12 hours

risks.why: WordPress MU plugin not implemented for content deployment
risks.impact: MEDIUM - AI suggestions cannot be deployed to client WordPress sites
risks.mitigation: P2: Implement Step 15 (WP MU Plugin). Webhook-based deployment. ETA: 16 hours

risks.item: Review vs Auto mode toggle missing
risks.why: No configuration for per-module review/auto mode switching
risks.impact: HIGH - Cannot gradually graduate modules from manual review to automation
risks.mitigation: P1: Add review_mode config table with module-level flags. Part of Step 03. ETA: 4 hours

risks.why: No crawler, no keyword tracking, no rank monitoring
risks.impact: HIGH - Foundation missing for anomaly detection and AI-SEO features
risks.mitigation: P1: Implement Step 07 (SERP Crawler). Use ScraperAPI or custom Selenium. ETA: 12 hours
